description: Modern linear algebra: linear systems, eigenvalues, least squares, and matrix factorizations.
source:
program main
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   use linear_algebra, only: solve
   implicit none
   real(real64) :: a(2,2), b(2), x(2)
   a = reshape([3.0_real64, 1.0_real64, 1.0_real64, 2.0_real64], [2,2])
   b = [9.0_real64, 8.0_real64]
   x = solve(a, b)
   if (maxval(abs(matmul(a,x)-b)) > 1.0e-10_real64) error stop 'incorrect solution'
   print *, 'x =', x
   print *, 'PASS fortran-lapack'
end program main

description: Create PNG plots from Fortran through Python and Matplotlib.
source:
program plot_trig
   use iso_fortran_env, only: dp => real64
   use pyplot_module, only: pyplot
   implicit none
   type(pyplot) :: plt
   integer :: i, status
   real(dp) :: x(101)
   real(dp), parameter :: pi = acos(-1.0_dp)

   x = [(2*pi*i/100, i = 0, 100)]
   call plt%initialize(grid=.true., legend=.true., &
      title='Sine and cosine', xlabel='x (radians)', &
      ylabel='Function value', use_oo_api=.true.)
   call plt%add_plot(x, sin(x), label='sin(x)', linestyle='b-')
   call plt%add_plot(x, cos(x), label='cos(x)', linestyle='r--')
   call plt%savefig('trig.png', istat=status)
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'Plot generation failed'
   print '(a)', 'Saved trig.png'
   print *, 'PASS pyplot-fortran'
end program plot_trig

description: Parse and write TOML configuration files.
source:
! Parse a small TOML document and retrieve its integer value.
program demo
   use tomlf, only: toml_table, toml_error, toml_parse, get_value
   implicit none
   type(toml_table), allocatable :: table
   type(toml_error), allocatable :: error
   integer :: answer, status
   call toml_parse(table, 'answer = 42', error=error)
   if (allocated(error)) error stop 'TOML parsing failed'
   call get_value(table, 'answer', answer, stat=status)
   if (status /= 0 .or. answer /= 42) error stop 'incorrect TOML value'
   print '(a,i0)', 'PASS toml-f answer=', answer
end program demo

description: Fast Fourier, sine, and cosine transforms.
source:
program main
   use fftpack, only: fft, ifft, rk
   implicit none
   complex(rk) :: x(4), y(4), restored(4)
   x = cmplx([1, 2, 3, 4], 0, kind=rk)
   y = fft(x)
   ! FFTPACK's backward transform is unnormalized.
   restored = ifft(y) / real(size(x), rk)
   if (maxval(abs(restored-x)) > 1.0e-10_rk) error stop 'FFT round trip failed'
   print *, 'Fourier coefficients:', y
   print *, 'PASS fftpack'
end program main

description: Find roots of scalar functions using bracketing and other solvers.
source:
! Solve x**2 - 2 = 0 with Brent's method.
! Module callbacks avoid executable-stack trampolines for internal procedures.
module audit_functions
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use root_module, only: root_solver
   implicit none
contains
   function equation(me, x) result(y)
      class(root_solver), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      real(wp) :: y
      y = x*x - 2.0_wp
   end function equation
end module audit_functions

program demo
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use root_module, only: brent_solver
   use audit_functions, only: equation
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x, residual
   integer :: status
   type(brent_solver) :: solver
   call solver%initialize(equation, rtol=1.0e-12_wp)
   call solver%solve(0.0_wp, 2.0_wp, x, residual, status)
   if (.not. ieee_is_finite(x)) error stop 'nonfinite root'
   if (status /= 0 .or. abs(x - sqrt(2.0_wp)) > 1.0e-9_wp) error stop 'incorrect root'
   print '(a,f15.12)', 'PASS roots-fortran sqrt(2)=', x
end program demo

description: One- to six-dimensional B-spline interpolation.
source:
program main
   use bspline_module, only: bspline_1d
   use bspline_kinds_module, only: wp, ip
   implicit none
   type(bspline_1d) :: spline
   integer(ip) :: status
   real(wp) :: value
   call spline%initialize([0.0_wp,1.0_wp,2.0_wp], [0.0_wp,2.0_wp,4.0_wp], 2_ip, status)
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'initialization failed'
   call spline%evaluate(0.5_wp, 0_ip, value, status)
   if (status /= 0 .or. abs(value-1.0_wp) > 1.e-10_wp) error stop 'incorrect spline'

end program main

description: Shape-preserving piecewise cubic interpolation.
source:
! Interpolate linear data and verify an interior value.
program demo
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use pchip_module, only: dpchim, dpchfe
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x(3), f(1,3), d(1,3), query(1), answer(1)
   integer :: status
   logical :: skip
   x = [0.0_wp, 1.0_wp, 2.0_wp]
   f(1,:) = 2*x + 1
   call dpchim(3, x, f, d, 1, status)
   if (status < 0) error stop 'derivative calculation failed'
   skip = .false.
   query = 0.5_wp
   call dpchfe(3, x, f, d, 1, skip, 1, query, answer, status)
   if (.not. ieee_is_finite(answer(1))) error stop 'nonfinite interpolation'
   if (status < 0 .or. abs(answer(1) - 2.0_wp) > 1.0e-12_wp) error stop 'incorrect interpolation'
   print '(a,f8.4)', 'PASS pchip value=', answer(1)
end program demo

description: Adaptive numerical integration, including improper and oscillatory integrals.
source:
module integrand
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   implicit none
contains
   function square(x) result(y)
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      real(wp) :: y
      y = x*x
   end function
end module
program main
   use quadpack, only: dqag
   use integrand, only: square, wp
   implicit none
   integer, parameter :: limit=100
   integer :: neval, status, last, iwork(limit)
   real(wp) :: value, error, work(4*limit)
   call dqag(square, 0.0_wp, 1.0_wp, 1.e-10_wp, 1.e-10_wp, 1, &
      value, error, neval, status, limit, 4*limit, last, iwork, work)
   print *, 'Integral, error estimate, status:', value, error, status
   if (status /= 0 .or. abs(value-1.0_wp/3) > 1.e-10_wp) error stop 'incorrect integral'
   print *, 'Integral of x squared:', value
   print *, 'PASS quadpack'
end program main

description: Adaptive Gaussian quadrature in one or more dimensions.
source:
! Integrate x**2 over [0,1]; verify the result rather than only printing it.
! Module callbacks avoid executable-stack trampolines for internal procedures.
module audit_functions
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use quadrature_module, only: integration_class_1d
   implicit none
contains
   function square(me, x) result(y)
      class(integration_class_1d), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      real(wp) :: y
      y = x*x
   end function square
end module audit_functions

program demo
   use iso_fortran_env, only: wp => real64
   use ieee_arithmetic, only: ieee_is_finite
   use quadrature_module, only: integration_class_1d
   use audit_functions, only: square
   implicit none
   type(integration_class_1d) :: integral
   real(wp) :: answer, estimate
   integer :: status
   call integral%initialize(fx=square, xl=0.0_wp, xu=1.0_wp, tolx=1.0e-10_wp, methodx=8)
   call integral%integrate(answer, status, estimate)
   if (.not. ieee_is_finite(answer)) error stop 'nonfinite integral'
   if (abs(answer - 1.0_wp/3.0_wp) > 1.0e-9_wp) error stop 'incorrect integral'
   print '(a,f15.12,a,i0)', 'PASS quadrature-fortran integral=', answer, ' status=', status
end program demo

description: Adaptive eighth-order Runge-Kutta integration of ordinary differential equations.
source:
module ode_functions
   use dop853_module, only: dop853_class, wp => dop853_wp
   implicit none
contains
   subroutine decay(me, x, y, derivative)
      class(dop853_class), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x, y(:)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: derivative(:)
      derivative = -y
   end subroutine
end module
program main
   use ode_functions
   implicit none
   type(dop853_class) :: solver
   real(wp) :: x, y(1)
   integer :: status
   logical :: initialized
   x = 0.0_wp
   y = 1.0_wp
   call solver%initialize(n=1, fcn=decay, status_ok=initialized)
   if (.not. initialized) error stop 'initialization failed'
   call solver%integrate(x, y, 1.0_wp, [1.e-10_wp], [1.e-10_wp], 0, status)
   if (status < 0 .or. abs(y(1)-exp(-1.0_wp)) > 1.e-8_wp) error stop 'incorrect ODE solution'
   print *, 'y(1) for dy/dx=-y:', y
   print *, 'PASS dop853'
end program main

description: Nonlinear equation solvers and nonlinear least-squares fitting.
source:
module equations
   use minpack_module, only: wp
   implicit none
contains
   subroutine residual(n, x, fvec, iflag)
      integer, intent(in) :: n
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x(n)
      real(wp), intent(out) :: fvec(n)
      integer, intent(inout) :: iflag
      fvec = [x(1)**2-2.0_wp, x(2)-3.0_wp]
   end subroutine
end module
program main
   use minpack_module, only: hybrd1
   use equations
   implicit none
   real(wp) :: x(2), fvec(2), work(19)
   integer :: status
   x = [1.0_wp,1.0_wp]
   call hybrd1(residual, 2, x, fvec, 1.e-10_wp, status, work, size(work))
   if (status /= 1 .or. maxval(abs(fvec)) > 1.e-8_wp) error stop 'nonlinear solve failed'
   print *, 'Solution (sqrt(2), 3):', x
   print *, 'PASS minpack'
end program main

description: Reproducible 64-bit Mersenne Twister random number generation.
source:
program main
   use mt19937_64, only: mt19937
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   implicit none
   type(mt19937) :: generator
   real(real64) :: first, repeated
   call generator%initialize(42)
   first = generator%genrand64_real2()
   call generator%initialize(42)
   repeated = generator%genrand64_real2()
   if (first /= repeated .or. first < 0 .or. first >= 1) error stop 'incorrect generator'
   print *, 'First uniform value for seed 42:', first
   print *, 'PASS mersenne-twister-fortran'
end program main

description: Linked lists storing values of different types under named keys.
source:
program main
   use linked_list_module, only: list
   implicit none
   type(list) :: values
   class(*), pointer :: item
   values = list(.false.)
   call values%add_clone('answer',42)
   call values%get('answer',item)
   if (.not. associated(item)) error stop 'missing value'
   select type(item)
   type is(integer)
      if (item /= 42) error stop 'incorrect value'
      print *, 'Stored answer:', item
   class default
      error stop 'incorrect type'
   end select
   call values%destroy()
   print *, 'PASS flist'
end program main

description: Directed acyclic graphs and topological ordering of dependencies.
source:
program main
   use dag_module, only: dag
   implicit none
   type(dag) :: graph
   integer, allocatable :: order(:)
   integer :: status
   call graph%set_vertices(3)
   call graph%set_edges(2,[1])
   call graph%set_edges(3,[2])
   call graph%toposort(order,status)
   if (status /= 0) error stop 'topological sort failed'
   if (any(order /= [1,2,3])) error stop 'incorrect dependency order'
   print *, 'Dependency order:', order
   call graph%destroy()
   print *, 'PASS daglib'
end program main

   implicit none

   call expression%parse('sin(x)^2 + cos(x)^2', ['x'])
   if (expression%error()) error stop 'expression parsing failed'
   call expression%evaluate([0.7_real64], result)
   if (expression%error() .or. abs(result-1.0_real64) > 1.e-12_real64) error stop 'incorrect evaluation'

description: Numerical derivatives and sparse Jacobian estimation.
source:
module functions
   use numdiff_kinds_module, only: wp
   use diff_module, only: diff_func
   implicit none
contains
   function square(me,x) result(y)
      class(diff_func), intent(inout) :: me
      real(wp), intent(in) :: x
      real(wp) :: y
      y = x*x
   end function
end module
program main
   use functions
   implicit none
   type(diff_func) :: derivative
   real(wp) :: value, error
   integer :: status
   call derivative%set_function(square)
   call derivative%compute_derivative(1, 2.0_wp, 0.0_wp, 4.0_wp, 1.e-10_wp, &
      -epsilon(1.0_wp), value, error, status)
   if (status /= 0 .or. abs(value-4.0_wp) > 1.e-7_wp) error stop 'incorrect derivative'
   print *, 'Derivative of x squared at 2:', value
   print *, 'PASS numdiff'
end program main

description: Read and write CSV files with typed columns.
source:
program main
   use csv_module, only: csv_file
   use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
   implicit none
   type(csv_file) :: file
   real(real64), allocatable :: column(:)
   logical :: ok
   call file%open('values.csv', n_cols=2, status_ok=ok)
   if (.not. ok) error stop 'open failed'
   call file%add(['x','y'])
   call file%next_row()
   call file%add([1.0_real64,2.0_real64])
   call file%next_row()
   call file%add([3.0_real64,6.0_real64])
   call file%next_row()
   call file%close(ok)
   if (.not. ok) error stop 'close failed'
   call file%read('values.csv', header_row=1, status_ok=ok)
   if (.not. ok) error stop 'read failed'
   call file%get(2, column, ok)
   if (.not. ok) error stop 'missing column'
   if (size(column) /= 2) error stop 'incorrect row count'
   if (any(abs(column-[2.0_real64,6.0_real64]) > 1.e-12_real64)) error stop 'incorrect values'
   print *, 'CSV y column:', column
   print *, 'PASS csv-fortran'
end program main

description: Date/time objects, durations, and calendar arithmetic.
source:
! Advance across a leap-year day and check the resulting calendar date.
program demo
   use datetime_module
   implicit none
   type(datetime) :: start, finish
   start = datetime(2024, 2, 28)
   finish = start + timedelta(days=2)
   if (finish%getYear() /= 2024 .or. finish%getMonth() /= 3 .or. finish%getDay() /= 1) &
      error stop 'incorrect calendar arithmetic'
   print '(a,a)', 'PASS datetime-fortran date=', finish%isoformat()
end program demo

description: Convenience routines for reading text files, tables, and paths.
